name: Condom
definition: sheath worn on the penis or in the vagina as a contraceptive and barrier.

name: Dental dam
definition: thin sheet used as an oral barrier.

name: Breast pump
definition: Pump that expresses breast milk; electric or manual, single or double.

name: Wearable breast pump
definition: Pump worn inside the bra; it works differently from a corded pump.

name: Nursing pad
definition: pad worn in the bra to absorb leaked milk.

name: Nipple cream
definition: cream for sore nipples while breastfeeding.

name: First-aid kit
definition: Kit sold and compared as one product, whatever place or vehicle it is made for; the standard and class it meets are noted.

name: Plaster
definition: small dressing on an adhesive strip (UK plaster).

name: Triangular bandage
definition: triangle of cloth used as a sling or to hold a dressing.

name: Neck support
definition: collar or brace that supports the neck.

name: Elbow support
definition: brace or sleeve that supports the elbow.

name: Wrist & hand support
definition: brace, splint or sleeve that supports the wrist or hand.

name: Orthotic insole
definition: insole made to treat or support the foot.

name: Compression stocking
definition: stocking with graded pressure made for a labelled medical purpose.

name: Leg prosthesis
definition: artificial leg or part of a leg.

name: Arm prosthesis
definition: artificial arm, hand or part of one.

name: Breast prosthesis
definition: artificial breast, including breast forms and packers.

name: Eye prosthesis
definition: artificial eye.

name: Facial prosthesis
definition: prosthesis replacing a facial or other external part.

name: Blood-pressure monitor cuff
definition: Cuff, tube or other part made for a blood-pressure monitor.

name: Glucose test strip
definition: one-use strip read by a blood glucose meter.

name: Glucose sensor
definition: Replacement sensor for a continuous or flash glucose monitor.

name: Hearing-aid battery
definition: battery made to power a hearing aid.

name: Hearing-aid ear tip
definition: Dome or tip fitted to a hearing aid in the ear canal.

name: Wheelchair part for one model
definition: Part or accessory made to fit one wheelchair model, including a cushion shaped for it.

name: Spectacle frame
definition: Frame sold for glazing; a frame with plain or no lenses sold as fashion is not here.

name: Spectacle lens
definition: lens sold for glazing.

name: Contact-lens solution
definition: solution for cleaning, storing or rinsing contact lenses.

name: Upper-arm blood-pressure monitor
definition: home device whose cuff wraps the upper arm and which reads blood pressure and pulse.

name: Wrist blood-pressure monitor
definition: home device worn on the wrist for a blood-pressure reading.

name: Wearable blood-pressure monitor
definition: watch-style or band-style device that measures blood pressure while worn.

name: Stick thermometer
definition: Electronic probe thermometer read in the mouth, rectum or under the arm.

name: Ear thermometer
definition: infrared thermometer that reads the eardrum.

name: Forehead thermometer
definition: infrared thermometer that reads the temple or forehead.

name: Blood glucose meter
definition: handheld meter that reads a drop of blood on a test strip (fingerstick).

name: Continuous glucose monitor
definition: worn sensor that measures glucose under the skin and sends readings on its own at short intervals.

name: Flash glucose monitor
definition: worn sensor whose readings are fetched by scanning it with a reader or phone.

name: Pulse oximeter
definition: clip or band device that reads blood oxygen saturation and pulse.

name: Personal ECG monitor
definition: handheld or worn device that records an electrocardiogram.

name: Infection test kit
definition: Self-test kit for an infection, for example COVID-19 or flu; a combined test counts as one product.

name: Pregnancy test
definition: one-use urine test that shows whether the user is pregnant.

name: Ovulation test
definition: one-use urine test that finds the hormone surge before ovulation.

name: Fertility monitor
definition: reusable reader with test sticks or sensors that tracks the fertile window.

name: Basal-body thermometer
definition: sensitive thermometer made to track resting body temperature for fertility.

name: Medical app
definition: Software that itself diagnoses or treats, or is cleared as a medical device; an app that only shows readings from a separate device is not this.

name: Nebuliser
definition: device that turns liquid medicine into a mist to be breathed in.

name: TENS machine
definition: pulse generator with skin pads, sold to relieve pain by nerve stimulation.

name: Muscle stimulator for pain
definition: muscle-stimulation unit with skin pads, sold to relieve pain.

name: Weighted blanket
definition: Blanket loaded with weight, made to treat a stated condition.

name: Orthopaedic pillow
definition: Shaped pillow made to treat a stated condition; a therapeutic weighted pillow is this too.

name: Pelvic-floor trainer
definition: device that trains the pelvic-floor muscles, sold with a stated medical purpose.

name: Vacuum erection device
definition: vacuum cylinder and pump used to obtain an erection, sold with a stated medical purpose.

name: Erection ring
definition: ring worn at the base of the penis to keep an erection, sold with a stated medical purpose.

name: Vaginal dilator
definition: Graduated dilator used to widen or restore vaginal capacity.

name: Walking stick
definition: single hand-held stick or cane.

name: Forearm crutch
definition: crutch with a forearm cuff and a handgrip.

name: Underarm crutch
definition: crutch that rests under the armpit.

name: Walking frame
definition: Frame without wheels, or with two front wheels, that the user lifts or pushes.

name: Rollator
definition: Walking support on three or four wheels with hand brakes; four-wheeled models usually have a seat and bag.

name: Knee walker
definition: wheeled frame with a knee rest, used in place of crutches for a lower-leg injury.

name: Manual wheelchair
definition: wheelchair propelled by the user or a pusher.

name: Powered wheelchair
definition: wheelchair driven by an electric motor.

name: Mobility scooter
definition: electric seated vehicle with tiller steering made for a person with limited mobility.

name: Portable ramp
definition: ramp for a wheelchair or scooter over steps or kerbs.

name: Patient lift
definition: hoist or lift that raises and moves a person.

name: Stairlift
definition: Chair or platform that carries a person up and down a staircase; fitted or free-standing.

name: Shower chair
definition: chair, stool or bench for sitting while washing.

name: Grab bar
definition: rail fixed or clamped to give a hand-hold, for example by a bath or toilet (UK grab rail).

name: Commode chair
definition: Chair with a seat opening and a removable pail, used as a toilet, also when made for use in a shower.

name: Raised toilet seat
definition: seat that raises the height of a toilet.

name: Incontinence product
definition: absorbent pad, brief or similar made for urinary or bowel leakage.

name: Stoma appliance
definition: bag, flange or similar supply for a stoma.

name: Care bed
definition: adjustable bed for nursing care (a hospital bed is this kind).

name: Pressure-relief mattress
definition: mattress made to prevent or treat pressure sores.

name: Pressure-relief cushion
definition: seat cushion made to prevent or treat pressure sores, including cushions used in wheelchairs.

name: Examination table
definition: table for a clinical examination.

name: Treatment couch
definition: couch for therapy or treatment.

name: Dental chair
definition: chair for dental treatment.

name: Medical ID bracelet
definition: wrist band carrying medical information.

name: Medical ID tag
definition: tag, card or keyring carrying medical information.

name: Fall detector
definition: worn device made mainly to sense a fall and call for help.

name: Care pendant
definition: Worn call button that summons help after a fall or medical event; some also sense falls automatically.

name: Wandering detector
definition: device that alerts carers when a person leaves a place.

name: Behind-the-ear hearing aid
definition: case behind the ear with a tube to an ear mould.

name: Receiver-in-canal hearing aid
definition: case behind the ear with a thin wire to a receiver in the ear canal.

name: In-the-ear hearing aid
definition: custom shell filling the outer ear.

name: In-the-canal hearing aid
definition: Custom device sitting in or deep in the ear canal; ITC, CIC and IIC are the shell styles.

name: Prescription glasses
definition: glasses with lenses made to the wearer's prescription.

name: Reading glasses
definition: glasses with fixed magnifying power, sold without a prescription.

name: Prescription sunglasses
definition: tinted spectacles with lenses made to a prescription.

name: Low-vision glasses
definition: spectacles with magnifying, prismatic or telescopic lenses in a spectacle frame, including flip-down magnifiers mounted on a frame.

name: Handheld magnifier
definition: magnifier held in the hand, made and sold as a low-vision aid.

name: Stand magnifier
definition: magnifier on a stand or flat base resting on the page, made and sold as a low-vision aid.

name: Soft contact lens
definition: Flexible lens worn on the eye, of any schedule, correction or colour; a coloured lens without power is included.

name: Rigid gas-permeable contact lens
definition: rigid lens worn on the eye.

name: Orthokeratology lens
definition: rigid lens worn overnight to reshape the cornea.

name: Scleral lens
definition: large rigid lens resting on the white of the eye.

name: White cane
definition: cane made for a blind or low-vision person to detect obstacles.

name: Communication aid
definition: device or board that helps a person speak or communicate.

name: Antihistamine tablets
definition: Tablet, capsule or liquid taken for allergy symptoms.

name: Allergy nasal spray
definition: spray used in the nose for allergy symptoms.

name: Cough suppressant
definition: medicine that suppresses cough.

name: Expectorant
definition: medicine that loosens phlegm.

name: Nasal decongestant
definition: medicine that clears a blocked nose.

name: Cold & flu remedy
definition: combined medicine for cold and flu symptoms.

name: Painkillers
definition: Tablet, capsule or liquid taken for pain or fever.

name: Pain-relief gel
definition: gel or cream rubbed on for joint or muscle pain.

name: Lidocaine patch
definition: adhesive patch with a local anaesthetic.

name: Migraine medicine
definition: medicine labelled for migraine.

name: Sleep aid
definition: Medicine labelled first as an aid to fall asleep; the same ingredient labelled first for allergy is an antihistamine.

name: Delay spray
definition: topical anaesthetic spray to delay ejaculation.

name: Emergency contraceptive pill
definition: pill taken after unprotected sex to prevent pregnancy.

name: Teething gel
definition: gel applied to the gums of a teething baby.

name: Medicinal enema
definition: Enema containing a medicine; a plain enema bulb or anal douche is not a medicine.

name: Nicotine replacement
definition: patch, gum, lozenge, spray or inhaler that supplies nicotine to help stop smoking.

name: Homeopathic single remedy
definition: Registered single homeopathic remedy sold with no stated use.

name: Multivitamin
definition: supplement that combines many vitamins in one product.

name: Vitamin D
definition: supplement whose single active ingredient is vitamin D.

name: Vitamin C
definition: supplement whose single active ingredient is vitamin C.

name: Magnesium
definition: supplement whose single active ingredient is magnesium.

name: Ashwagandha
definition: supplement made from ashwagandha root or extract.

name: Probiotic
definition: live-microbe supplement.

name: Fish oil
definition: omega-3 oil supplement from fish.

name: Collagen
definition: collagen in powder, drink or capsule, including those sold for skin, hair and nails.

name: Restorative essence
definition: tonic or essence sold for health (for example essence of chicken).

name: Multi-ingredient supplement
definition: product mixing ingredient classes (for example a joint formula, or a hair, skin and nails formula).

name: Protein powder
definition: powder sold for its protein, for training or recovery.

name: Protein bar
definition: bar sold for its protein.

name: Creatine
definition: creatine sold as a training supplement.

name: Pre-workout
definition: powder or drink taken before training.

name: Amino acids
definition: amino acids (for example BCAA, arginine, glutamine) sold for training.

name: Electrolytes & energy gels
definition: gel, tablet or drink mix for hydration or energy during exercise.

name: Meal-replacement shake
definition: shake or powder sold to replace a meal.

name: Medical-condition formula
definition: Formula made for a medical condition, such as hypoallergenic, amino-acid or metabolic formulas; a food, not a supplement.

name: Toilet safety frame
definition: free-standing or toilet-fixed frame with armrests round a toilet that helps a person sit down and rise.

name: Bath lift
definition: powered seat that lowers a person into the bath and raises them out again.

name: Tub transfer bench
definition: bench that straddles the bath wall so a person sits outside the bath and slides across into it.

name: Bed rail
definition: rail or assist handle fitted to a bed to prevent falls or help a person sit up and stand.

name: Penile traction device
definition: device that stretches the penis, sold with a stated medical purpose such as Peyronie's disease or length after surgery.

name: Mobility vehicle lift
definition: powered lift fitted inside a car or on its hitch that raises a mobility scooter or wheelchair into or onto the vehicle.

name: Low-vision monocular
definition: small handheld telescope made and sold as a low-vision aid for seeing at a distance.

name: Eye-gaze device
definition: eye tracker fixed to a computer or tablet so a person with little movement can control it and communicate by gaze.

name: Tubular bandage
definition: elastic or gauze tube pulled over a limb to support it or hold a dressing.

name: Blister plaster
definition: hydrocolloid cushion plaster made to protect and heal a blister.

name: Corn & callus remover
definition: medicated plaster, pad or liquid (for example salicylic acid) labelled to remove corns or calluses.

name: Wound-closure strip
definition: thin adhesive strips that hold the edges of a cut together while it heals.

name: Heat patch
definition: self-heating patch stuck on the body and sold to relieve muscle or joint pain.

name: Liquid bandage
definition: spray or liquid that dries to a protective film over a small wound.

name: Milk collector
definition: cup worn in the bra that catches milk leaking from the other breast, without suction.

name: Manual blood-pressure kit
definition: Gauge with arm cuff and hand bulb, read by listening with a stethoscope; sold with or without the stethoscope.

name: Peak flow meter
definition: handheld tube with a scale that measures how fast a person can breathe out, used to monitor asthma.

name: HbA1c test kit
definition: one-use kit that measures average blood glucose (HbA1c) from a fingerstick blood sample.

name: Steam inhaler
definition: device that makes warm steam to be breathed in for cold, cough or sinus relief, without liquid medicine.

name: Electronic magnifier
definition: camera-and-screen device, handheld or desktop, that enlarges print and images for a low-vision user (video magnifier, CCTV).

name: Fat burner
definition: thermogenic supplement sold to support fat loss alongside training.

name: Protein snack
definition: snack other than a bar (chips, crisps, cookies) sold for its protein.

name: Contact-lens drops
definition: drops put in the eye with lenses in place to rewet and soothe them.

name: Roller bandage
definition: long strip of bandage wound on a roll.

name: Back support
definition: brace or belt that supports the back.
